tests.reason: sharing posts to the whole community, an invite messages a real person and 'In meinen Kalender' writes another member's calendar; staging shares the production Supabase project, so none of it is exercised there. These suites prove it with the real services over a fake PostgREST: the rule matrix over every source type (own + upcoming → yes; cancelled / done / ended / series → no), an event entry still shared as the event, the snapshot holding only title/times/emoji/status and the place only on request, the member's card title, the invite card's choices, 'In meinen Kalender' (public calendar_entry posts only, never the author's, current card re-read, cancelled/finished refused, idempotent), and Vitana's tools (health entries need sensitive_ack).
